headline: CONTRA answers the count — three CONTINUEs keep your score
lede: The arcade's second chance landed on the shelf. GAME OVER now reads, CONTINUE? counts 9…0, and any key or tap buys a return to the fight with the bank you earned — three times per game, Konami-style. And when the other lane's score-extend landed mid-build, the mark learned to carry through the continue too.

notes.text: CONTINUE (#3042, PR #3044): purse of 3 per game, world-tick countdown, score carried, armed Konami runs return at 30 (the NES continue law). Window is pure sim law (contPhase); the carry enters at makeGame(score=0) so every pre-continue pin stands. Named mutants score-wipe, window-short, count-stalls, rung-resale all die by name.

Two CONTRA lanes, one cycle: the score-extend (#3043) merged under this branch mid-build. The seam it exposed — the extend mark is a RUN property — now holds at the CONTINUE entry too (extMark derives the rung from the carried bank). Full battery re-ran post-rebase: 320/320 + 200/200.

Two harness truths from a loaded box: the extend pays one tick AFTER the crossing kill — live polls must freeze on the PAID state, not the crossing-intermediate; and a pinned-seed duck sequence can respawn between its presses (#3038's flake window, for its owner lane to harden).

Never-dry (#1571): the kick said CONTRA -1 weak with every README gap CLOSED — the cabinet's continue rule was the live gap. It is now CLOSED too; the shelf's Contra is one arcade rule nearer the 1987 machine.
